name: macp_quorum_approval_request
description: ApprovalRequest: opens the approval request. A Session accepts at most one (RFC-MACP-0011 Sections 4 and 5). Sent as message_type ApprovalRequest in mode macp.mode.quorum.v1.

request_id.description: Identifier of the request. Every ballot references it.

details.description: Opaque context for the request; empty if none. Base64-encoded (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 10.3).

required_approvals.description: Number of approvals required. Must be greater than zero and must not exceed the number of eligible participants. A policy threshold, if any, replaces it.
